candidate_relations.reason: The benchmark requires post-COVID-19 syndrome with both osteoarticular and neurological manifestations. Reactive arthritis addresses the joint symptoms and proposed infectious trigger but does not include the back paresthesia/neurological component and imposes a narrower arthritis diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures a post-SARS-CoV-2 osteoarticular process but omits the neurological manifestations and broader post-COVID-19 syndrome composite.

case_quality_flags: Joint symptoms arose months after infection and shortly after vaccination, making the precise trigger of the osteoarticular manifestations somewhat ambiguous.
